description: Reset selects only default base/fs/git catalog checks without backup and challenge updates preserve explicit check-level challenges.

input.initial_yaml:
---
challenge: Yes
includes:
  - custom
version: 1.0.0
checks:
- from: custom
  test: custom
  method: Regex
  enable: true
  description: "custom"

cases.expected_output:
backup_created=no
challenge=Math
includes=base,fs,git
check_count=3
check=base|StartWith|true|Default|base check
check=fs|Contains|false|Yes|fs disabled
check=git|Regex|true|Default|git reset

input.initial_yaml:
---
challenge: Math
includes:
  - base
  - fs
version: 0.2.2
checks:
- from: base
  test: sudo
  method: StartWith
  enable: true
  challenge: Math
  description: "base challenge stays math"
- from: fs
  test: rm
  method: Contains
  enable: false
  description: "fs default challenge"

cases.expected_output:
challenge=Enter
includes=base,fs
check_count=2
check=base|StartWith|true|Math|base challenge stays math
check=fs|Contains|false|Default|fs default challenge
